Latham has gone on to make another hundred, his 6th and Nicholls looks set as well. The Kiwis still trail by another 303 and will have to bat the whole day tomorrow to wipe it out, or get close to the Bangladeshi total. Do join us at 0300 IST (2130 GMT, previous day) for all the action from Day 4. Unfortunately, there will be NO COMMENTARY for this game, due to lack of television feed. But we will provide you a summary at the end of the day. Adios! Take Care!

Taskin Ahmed shot to limelight, getting Kane Williamson as his maiden Test wicket. Taylor and Latham then had a quick stand before Rabbi got rid of the former. Since then, Latham and Nicholls have been firm.

Starting the day at 542/7, the visitors continued their excellent show with the bat as Sabbir Rahman too, got to his half century in his first Test innings away from home. Bangladesh then declared with an hour to go in the first session and also managed to pick up Jeet Raval around Lunch. That would have lifted their spirits but then the middle order kept them at bay.

The drizzle has gotten heavier and the umpires have decided to call it STUMPS ON DAY 3. The Black Caps have finally got their way back into the game. It was all Bangladesh for the first two days, but today, the home side has come to the party.
